edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner from the untrusted msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
transfer reads and writes balances keyed on msg.sender.
approve writes allowed keyed on msg.sender.
transferFrom spends allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller address.
approveAndCall writes allowed keyed on msg.sender and forwards it to receiveApproval.
Owner state variable is initialized from msg.sender in the constructor.
transferOwnership stages the pending owner in newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
Constructor assigns the fixed total supply to _totalSupply.
Constructor credits the entire supply to balances[owner].
totalSupply reads _totalSupply when computing the supply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
transfer debits msg.sender and credits 'to' in balances.
approve writes the allowance into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom debits 'from' and credits 'to' in balances.
transferFrom decrements the spender allowance in allowed.
approveAndCall writes the approval into the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall forwards control to an external receiveApproval call on the untrusted spender.
The spender contract can re-enter the token (approve/transferFrom) during receiveApproval.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external ERC20 transfer on an arbitrary tokenAddress.
The arbitrary token contract regains control; call is owner-gated so reentrancy risk is limited.
transfer uses SafeMath.sub on the sender balance.
transfer uses SafeMath.add on the recipient balance.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub on balance and allowance.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.add on the recipient balance.
totalSupply uses SafeMath.sub on _totalSupply.
transfer destination parameter flows into the balances credit.
transfer amount parameter flows into the SafeMath debit and credit.
approve spender parameter becomes the allowed mapping key.
approve amount parameter is written to allowed.
transferFrom 'from' parameter keys the balance and allowance updates.
transferFrom 'to' parameter receives the credited balance.
transferFrom amount parameter drives the SafeMath operations.
approveAndCall spender parameter is both the allowance key and the external call target.
approveAndCall amount parameter is written to allowed and forwarded externally.
approveAndCall data parameter is forwarded verbatim to receiveApproval.
transferAnyERC20Token tokenAddress parameter is the target of the external call.
transferAnyERC20Token amount parameter is forwarded to the external transfer.
transferOwnership parameter is stored into the newOwner state variable.

transferFrom.to is a parameter used only by transferFrom and collapses into it.
transferFrom.tokens is a parameter used only by transferFrom and collapses into it.
approveAndCall.spender is the external call target of approveAndCall and merges into it.
